verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MWENNA musanyuke
Yesu ye Kabaka;
Ebitonde byonna,
Biyimbe n'essanyu:
Muyimuse emitiima,
Musanyuke,mujaguze.

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Obwakabaka bwe
Bwe butaliggwaawo;
Alina-obuyinza,
Mu nsi ne mu ggulu.
Muyimuse emitiima,
Musanyuke,mujaguze.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ali ku mukono
Gwa ddyo gwa Katonda;
-Abalabe be bonna
Balikungubaga.
Muyimuse emitiima,
Musanyuke,mujaguze.
